# Deployment Checklist

From: lee@acme.example
Subject: docs

The onboarding guide is updated, have a look when you can.

# Expense Policy
Meals up to 50 USD per day are reimbursable while travelling. Submit receipts
within 30 days through the finance portal. Manager approval is required above 500 USD.

# Onboarding Guide
New hires receive a laptop on day one. Set up email, VPN and the password
manager during the first week. Your buddy will walk you through team rituals.

# Password Reset
Use the self-service portal to reset your password. Passwords must be 14+
characters. After three failed attempts your account is locked for 15 minutes.

# VPN Setup Guide
To connect to the corporate VPN, install the AcmeVPN client, sign in with SSO,
and select the region closest to you. If the connection drops, restart the client.
Contact the helpdesk for persistent VPN issues.
